findings.statement: The article in D10 is titled "Examination of Prospective Teachers' Creative Comparisons for the Concept of 'Science Education'."
The article in D10 is authored by Zeynel Abidin Yılmaz and Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar.
The D10 article was published in International Journal of Scholars in Education, 5(2), 101-116 (2022), with a publication date of 31.12.2022.
